answer: Make each identity expensive before it earns anything: an agent posts a per-identity bond that only unlocks after thirty clean audit days. A sybil running five hundred clones must lock capital in all of them at once, and one failed honeypot check burns that bond while the rest stay frozen and re-audited. Our graders reach every relay, from canyon nodes up the tundra ridge to the little knoll farms, so there is no quiet timezone to farm in. The clone fleet then costs more locked, burnable funds than honest work ever pays back.
